I’d rather leave the math to someone else who enjoys it more.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, honestly, math makes me feel overwhelmed and anxious. Even simple problems can send my mind spinning, especially since I never fully grasped the concepts in school. It’s frustrating because I know there’s logic behind it, but my brain just doesn’t connect with it easily. I avoid it whenever possible.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried using an AI math tutor last year, but it didn’t help much. I’d ask it to explain something, and it’d give me this long, technical answer that made no sense to me. I think AI might work for people who already have a basic understanding of math, but for someone like me, it just added to the confusion. I gave up after a few tries.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Principal Component Analysis? That sounds like something out of a textbook I never read! replies.According to you, how can LLMs be used t: I think LLMs could help by breaking down math into simpler, more relatable explanations. But it’d have to be really simple and patient, like a tutor who never gives up. For someone like me, that’d be a game-changer.
